note: Bundle rules added after the PROMPT-28 security review (PLAZA_PACKAGES.md §1). Server bundle.ts and host bundle.py must agree on every case: `ok:false` = the bundle is refused (reason given).
forbidden_paths_rule: case-insensitive, at any depth: a file named .mcp.json, .envrc, opencode.json, opencode.jsonc; .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json; .codex/config.toml or .codex/hooks.json; anything under a .vscode/, .idea/, .devcontainer/, .husky/, .cursor/, .gemini/, .opencode/ or .codex/ directory (the installer generates .codex/agents itself). Reason: agent / IDE configuration that runs commands by itself (hooks, MCP servers, tasks, plugins).
hidden_characters_rule: refused in every file that decodes as UTF-8 and in every manifest string: U+061C, U+180E, U+200B, U+200E, U+200F, U+202A–U+202E, U+2060–U+2064, U+2066–U+2069, U+FFF9–U+FFFB, U+E0000–U+E007F, and U+FEFF anywhere but the first character of a file. U+200C / U+200D (ZWNJ / ZWJ: scripts, emoji) stay allowed. Reason: instructions the Owner and the reviewer cannot see.
depth_rule: manifest JSON nesting deeper than 32 (an object or array inside 32 others) → refused.
